description: A head under a run of concealed light: pale marble walls, warm stone underfoot, a walk-in shower with no door and no threshold against black marble. The walnut vanity has a stone bowl on it and a mirror the width of the wall, lit round its edge. It never fogs. A towel warms on a brass rail by the door.

window.description: A high slot of frosted glass under the ceiling. It lets the day in and nobody look back.
window.name: the frosted slot

name: Residence 5-A en-suite
